description.value: You excel at underwater sports, and you are now particularly adept at feats of strength while unburdened by gravity. You can use this to your advantage in combat. When you successfully [[/act grapple]] a creature while underwater or in zero gravity, your target must attempt a saving throw against the higher of your class DC or Athletics DC. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its next turn.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
